column1: # Example: Proteins co-purifying with the chaperonin TRiC/CCT from mouse retina rod photoreceptors (FLAG-tagged Tcp-1alpha transgenic line, anti-FLAG pulldown of the intact 900 kDa complex), combined from DDA (Duke) and DIA (IDeA) mass spectrometry datasets

# Brooks C, Salcedo-Tacuma D, Mascari I, et al. 2026. Mapping the chaperonin TRiC/CCT interactome in mouse photoreceptors reveals functional significance for energy metabolism. PLoS One 21(7):e0345843. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0345843

# Source: pone.0345843.s002.xlsx (S2 Table, Combined TRiC interactome), sheet "CombinedDataset" (https://journals.plos.org/plosone/article/file?id=10.1371/journal.pone.0345843.s002&type=supplementary)

# Cutoff: the paper's candidate interactor criteria (log2FC >= 1 and adjusted p < 0.05 in either dataset; DDA also >= 2 unique peptides); 226 proteins in the combined table; top 149 by the lowest adjusted p value (ties broken by max log2FC); bait Tcp1 (tagged TRiC subunit, not listed in the table) added as row 1
